booking.howItWorks: Parties and events are booked by emailing play@openplaypickleball.com. Court reservations and open play are booked online through CourtReserve (free account required).

otherLinks.what: Book a court, open play, memberships (CourtReserve)

packages.name: Party / Event Court Time
packages.description: Private party or event (birthday, corporate team building, holiday party). Minimum 20 guests, 2 courts, 2 hours. Courts $50 per court per hour, plus a $10 per guest fee covering paddle rentals, balls, the private party room and a dedicated party coordinator. For 20-30 guests the venue suggests 4 to 5 courts.
includes: Dedicated party coordinator for the whole session
Use of the private party room (with guest fee)
Paddle rentals and balls (with guest fee)

packages.name: Private Court Reservation
packages.description: Dedicated court for your group, max 6 players. Base court rate $52/hour ($13 per share for a foursome) at Drop-In rates; members pay less depending on tier. Empty slots under 4 players are billed at $13. Book up to 28 days out depending on membership.

food.name: Catering from Nonna's or Pastosa
food.description: Optional; typically runs about $20 per person. You may also bring your own food and refreshments.

addOns.name: Party guest fee
addOns.description: Covers paddle rentals, balls, use of the private party room and a dedicated party coordinator.

addOns.name: Instruction (optional)
addOns.description: $100 per instructor per hour, on a separate court to teach new players.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food?
faq.a: You are always welcome to bring your own food and refreshments to celebrate your event.

faq.q: Do I need a membership to play?
faq.a: OPEN TO THE PUBLIC! Paid membership not required to play but a free CourtReserve account is required to book and participate.
A max of 6 players are allowed per court. Players 5 & 6 pay their individual share rate based on their membership level.

faq.q: What if fewer than 4 players book a court?
faq.a: The empty "Ghost Slots" are billed at the full Drop-In rate ($13.00) and must be covered by the players present.
Cancellation: Up to 4 hours in advance without penalty.

Open Play (2-hr sessions) is $18.00 per session for Drop-In players, $9.00 for Silver Members, $10.00 with the College Pass, and free for Plus, Platinum and Weekday (M-F 7am-5pm, excludes holidays) members.

faq.q: What is the minimum for a party?
How do I book a party?
faq.a: Email us to book your event at play@openplaypickleball.com.
